title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 20 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Launches Free AI Services at Three National Libraries
stories.headline_zh: 落實數位平權 臺灣三座國立圖書館啟用免費 AI 服務

sentences.en: Taiwan's education ministry launched free AI computer zones at three national libraries.
sentences.zh: 臺灣教育部在三座國立圖書館正式啟用了免費的 AI 電腦專區。

sentences.en: Visitors with a library card can use paid AI models without any cost.
sentences.zh: 持有借閱證的民眾不須付費，就能使用原本需要訂閱的 AI 模型。

sentences.en: Each library offers five fast computers for research, learning, and image creation.
sentences.zh: 每座圖書館都配備了五臺高效能電腦，供研究、學習與圖像創作使用。

sentences.en: To protect personal privacy, the computers do not save any user records.
sentences.zh: 為了保護個人隱私，這些電腦不會保留任何使用者的操作紀錄。

stories.headline_en: Google Partners With Blue Origin to Build AI Computing in Space
stories.headline_zh: Google 攜手藍色起源 推進太空 AI 運算衛星計畫

sentences.en: Google and Blue Origin announced a bold plan to send AI computers into space.
sentences.zh: Google 與藍色起源公司宣布一項大膽計畫，準備將 AI 電腦送上太空。

sentences.en: They aim to launch special satellites using a heavy rocket in 2029.
sentences.zh: 他們目標在 2029 年利用重型火箭發射搭載運算設備的衛星。

sentences.en: In space, these machines can collect abundant solar power all day long.
sentences.zh: 在太空中，這些機器可以整天蒐集充足的太陽能電力。

sentences.en: Scientists hope space-based systems will help support future artificial intelligence growth.
sentences.zh: 科學家希望太空運算系統未來能協助支撐人工智慧的持續成長。

stories.headline_en: High Fuel and Flight Costs Slightly Curb US Thanksgiving Travel
stories.headline_zh: 油價與機票上漲 美國感恩節旅遊人潮三年來首度微幅下滑

sentences.en: Fewer Americans plan to travel for Thanksgiving this year due to rising costs.
sentences.zh: 受到物價上漲影響，今年計畫在感恩節出遊的美國民眾人數略微減少。

sentences.en: About eighty-one million people will still take trips away from home next week.
sentences.zh: 下週仍有約八千一百萬名旅客會離家出門過節或旅遊。

sentences.en: Higher gas prices and expensive plane tickets made some families change their plans.
sentences.zh: 較高的油價與昂貴的機票價格，讓部分家庭決定調整原訂行程。

sentences.en: However, more travelers are choosing buses, trains, and cruise ships instead of flying.
sentences.zh: 不過，越來越多旅客改搭巴士、火車與郵輪，取代搭飛機出行。
